content: It is possible to increase the capacity of the Jasper model by stacking these operations. Our largest version uses 54 convolutional layers (333M parameters), while our small model uses 34 (201M parameters). We use residual connections to enable this level of depth. We investigate a number of residual options and propose a new residual connection topology we call Dense Residual (DR).
